description: Works without an account. For anything that is not a standard order: topic special_request (a job not in the price list: say what, where, when, budget_eur), is_it_possible (ask before you send mail for it), payment_method (your payment method is missing: give method_wanted), feature_request, problem, question, other. A human answers, usually within one business day. Without api_key you get a ticket: read the answer with check_inquiry.

api_key.description: Your hm_... key. Only needed if your MCP client cannot send the "Authorization: Bearer" header.

body.description: What you need or want to know.

email.description: Optional: where the answer should go.

method_wanted.description: topic payment_method: the method you want (e.g. lightning, usdc-solana, sepa, card).

name: contact_human
title: Ask the human (inquiry)
